data.name: Samuelel
data.gender_notes: Samuelel is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Name of a prophet in the Old Testament who was called by God as a child. He grew to be a faithful servant of God and played a significant role in preparing the way for King David. The name Samuelel means 'heard of God'. The name Samuelel carries the meaning “Heard by God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Samuelel usually hope their child will grow to embody heard by god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes faith and obedience to God.
data.etymology: Samuelel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Heard by God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Samuelel total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: שמואלל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: שמואל הוא שם עברי שפירושו 'אל שמע' או 'האל שמע'. השם שמואל מורכב משתי מילים: 'שמע' שפירושו 'לשמוע' ו'אל' שפירושו 'אלוהים'. השם נמצא בתנ'ך ומתייחס לשמואל הנביא, שהיה אחד הנביאים החשובים ביותר בישראל.

in_greek.name: Σαμουήλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Σαμουήλ είναι όνομα ελληνικό που προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή λέξη 'שמואל' (Shmuel). Στη Βίβλο, ο Σαμουήλ ήταν προφήτης και δικαστής του λαού Ισραήλ. Το όνομα σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός άκουσεν' ή 'Ο Θεός εισέκουσεν', υπογραμμίζοντας τη σχέση του Θεού με τον άνθρωπο.

in_latin.name: Samuelel
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Samuelel derivatur ex hebraico 'שמואל' (Shmuel), quod significat 'Deus audivit' vel 'Deus exaudivit'. In Ecclesia primitiva, nomen Samuelel erat usitatum ad significandum prophetam et iudicem populi Israel. Nomen ipsum indicat exauditionem Dei et eius providentiam.

in_english.name: Samuelel
in_english.meaning: Heard by God or God has heard
in_english.long_meaning: The name Samuelel originates from the Hebrew name 'שמואל' (Shmuel), which means 'Heard by God' or 'God has heard'. In the Bible, Samuel was a prophet and judge of Israel, anointed by God to lead His people. The name carries significant spiritual meaning, reflecting a direct connection between God and humanity. Throughout Christian tradition, the name Samuelel symbolizes divine attention and providence.

data.cultural_impact: The name Samuelel holds great significance as a biblical name in the Christian tradition. It serves as a reminder of the profound idea that no matter how young or inexperienced one may be, they can still bear great importance and be chosen by God for a purpose in the world. The story of the prophet Samuel also demonstrates the importance of obedience, courage, and faithfulness in serving God and carrying out His will.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Samuelel bears a deep spiritual significance as it is derived from the Hebrew word 'shama', which means 'to hear'. It symbolizes listening to and obeying the voice of God, just like the biblical prophet Samuel did. The name encourages individuals to remain attuned to God's call and guidance in their lives, in order to fulfill their destiny and live out their purpose as faithful servants of God.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Samuel means "asked of God" in Hebrew. The name Samuelel can be interpreted as "God's asked one," emphasizing the importance of seeking divine guidance in one's life.

biblical_reference.note: The name Samuel is given to the prophet by Hannah, who prayed for a child.

historical_references.reference: Samuelel was a common name among the Hebrew people during the Babylonian exile in the 6th century BCE.
Historical records show that A Samuelel is mentioned in the Old Testament book of 1 Samuel as a high priest. The name Samuelel carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Samuelel remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named Peter Samuelel in Athens, Greece credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Samuelel, which means "Heard by God". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.
